drawDB

Free, simple, and intuitive database schema editor and SQL generator.

DrawDB is a robust and user-friendly database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor right in your browser. Build diagrams with a few clicks, export and import SQL scripts, generate migrations, customize your editor, and more without creating an account. See the full set of features on [here](https://drawdb.app/). ## Getting Started ### Local Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb cd drawdb npm install npm run dev ``` ### Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb cd drawdb npm install npm run build ``` ### Docker Build ```bash docker build -t drawdb . docker run -p 3000:80 drawdb ``` If you want to enable sharing, set up the [server](https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb-server) and environment variables according to `.env.sample`. This is optional unless you need to share files. ## Contributing Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines on how to contribute to this project. ## Support - Join discussions: [Discord](https://discord.gg/BrjZgNrmR6)

Free, simple, and intuitive database schema editor and SQL generator.

DrawDB is a robust and user-friendly database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor right in your browser. Build diagrams with a few clicks, export and import SQL scripts, generate migrations, customize your editor, and more without creating an account. See the full set of features on here.

Getting Started

Local Development

git clone https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb
cd drawdb
npm install
npm run dev

Build

git clone https://github.com/drawdb-io/drawdb
cd drawdb
npm install
npm run build

Docker Build

docker build -t drawdb .
docker run -p 3000:80 drawdb

If you want to enable sharing, set up the server and environment variables according to .env.sample. This is optional unless you need to share files.

Contributing

Please see CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines on how to contribute to this project.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An intuitive, browser-based database schema designer and visual entity-relationship mapping tool.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: DrawDB is a powerful, free, and intuitive database schema editor that runs entirely within the browser, eliminating the need for complex local installations. It allows developers to visually design entity-relationship diagrams, define tables, configure relationships, and set data types using a fluid drag-and-drop interface. The tool can automatically generate raw SQL export scripts for various major relational database management systems. By streamlining the initial database architecture phase, it helps teams collaborate and iterate on schema designs rapidly.
keyFeatures: Visual Schema Editor: Design complex database architectures using a highly responsive, drag-and-drop canvas interface.
Multi-Dialect Export: Automatically generate accurate DDL SQL scripts for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and SQL Server.
Relationship Management: Easily define and visualize complex foreign key constraints and table relationships.
Browser-Based Execution: Runs entirely client-side in the browser, ensuring privacy and eliminating server dependencies.
Template Library: Kickstart projects using a variety of pre-built schema templates for common application architectures.

useCases.title: Database Prototyping

useCases.title: Schema Documentation

useCases.title: Team Collaboration
useCases.description: Share visual schema designs with stakeholders to ensure alignment on data structures.

useCases.title: Migration Planning
useCases.description: Visually map out complex structural changes when planning major database migrations or refactors.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Software engineers, database administrators, and technical architects who need a fast, accessible way to design and document relational databases.
